about: The crypt's Hidden alcove (docs/milestones/connected-biomes.md, CB11): A secret room behind cracked rock: a small floating slab, its reward for each wizard as the party steps in. Its edge a broken lip (crypt_edge) and an invisible wall (its void a wall), sockets on its east and south and west sides for the bridges. tools/ground_shape.py draws crypt_secret_a_ground.tscn and its art from this.
